scenarios.title: Full refund of a May purchase, paid back in July

expect.working: Sam, asOf 2026-10-03. Everyday months Apr-Sep before any purchase: 110000, 160000, 360000, 130000, 135000, 185000; typical everyday E is their median (mean of the 3rd and 4th when sorted). Bills 180000 + set-aside 30000 come off 400000 income, so typicalLeft = 190000 - E. The October spending so far (10000) is below E, so monthLeft = typicalLeft; and the unspent anchor is 2026-10-03, after every May/June/July line, so unspent stays 240000 and a 5000 check leaves 235000. A 1,000,000 fridge in May is refunded in full in July. The refund is re-dated to May and nets the purchase to 0: May everyday 160000, July unchanged 130000. Sorted 110000,130000,135000,160000,185000,360000 -> E = (135000+160000)/2 half-up = 147500 (same as no purchase). typicalLeft 190000-147500 = 42500.

expect.working: Sam, asOf 2026-10-03. Everyday months Apr-Sep before any purchase: 110000, 160000, 360000, 130000, 135000, 185000; typical everyday E is their median (mean of the 3rd and 4th when sorted). In date order: June 400000 and July 600000 both credit May (net 0, May everyday 160000); the last 100000 stays in July as money in. expect.working: Sam, asOf 2026-10-03.
